assets.promptEssence: A raised printed field for the title band: lit top rim, shaded lower rim, and a fine paper grain across the surface the name and cost sit in.

assets.title: Rune frame — lower information strip
assets.promptEssence: A recessed printed strip for the type line and rules area: shadowed upper rim, lit lower rim, paper grain — a surface the text sits in rather than on.

assets.title: Rune frame — status band surface

assets.title: Rune frame — P/T plate
assets.promptEssence: The power/toughness plate as a distinct object: a small, strongly bevelled tile with a tight radius and a contact shadow, so it reads as fixed to the card rather than printed on it.
